works.body:
初めまして。
本日初めて、わをんさんの『にじさんじ百鬼夜行シリーズ』を拝見したのですが、ビジュアルとストーリーにズブズブとなってしまい、いつの間にか最新回まで追いついたうえ同人誌も2冊買っていました。(大変素晴らしかったです)
前置きが大変長くなりましたが、
今回私は『にじさんじ百鬼夜行シリーズのまななつ集合絵』をご依頼させていただきたいです。
理由としては『まななつが好き』というのと『(あるかも分からないですが)本編での3人揃った出番が待てない』という2点になります。(更に付け加えると、他の方のメッシャーズが素晴らし過ぎてああいうの見たいとなったのもあります)
シチュエーションはわをんさんの趣味嗜好にお任せさせていただきますので、お時間や依頼額に問題ありませんでしたら、是非共よろしくお願いいたします。

Hello! I would like to make a request for an illustration. Could you draw Nijisanji's Amemori Sayo looking directly at the viewer in a library at sunset? I want the illustration to have an unsettling atmosphere. I look forward to working with you!

you (nuance of either deep affection or contempt)

Nice to meet you, my name is Razaanya.

I was impressed by the way you used lines in your illustrations (especially in your latest two works), so
so I sent this request to you.

I'm a live-streamer on YouTube in the form of Bami-niku, and I'd like you to draw my character (myself)!

The pose, composition, clothes, accessories, etc. can be done as you like.
You can draw the pose, the composition, the clothes, the accessories, etc. as you like, but the hair style, the hair color, the eye color, and the ribbon are the images that leave the identity.

The illustrations you draw will be used for the following purposes.
　Personal viewing
　Use on SNS
　Video thumbnails

We will not use them for commercial purposes.

We have a web page with full body images as a reference URL.

We look forward to your consideration.

https://razanixya.myportfolio.com/visuals

Wa-on, nice to meet you. I always watch the Niji Sanji Hyakki Yagou series that you draw. I would like to request you to draw "The Messers of Niji Sanji Hyakki Yagou who are viewing cherry blossoms".
When the acceptance started, I wasn't sure who to ask Wa-on-san to draw, but at first I wanted my guess to be drawn by my favorite artist, so I made the request.


Details
Akina: She's eating the bento and dumplings she brought with her. She is holding onigiri (rice balls) and dango (dumplings) in both hands to give the feeling of "appetite > hanami".
Fuwachi: He's drinking Hanami sake. His hairstyle is his normal hairstyle (since that one was a new costume ver)
Mayu: He's inwardly enjoying the hanami in Mesha, and his expression is smiling gently.
Other: the three muscots (Kamekku-kun, Uchina Irokiro, and Fuwatchi Cruller) are also with him.


It's okay to go at your pace, Wagon. I look forward to working with you.

Nice to meet you!
I've been wanting you to draw a picture of Tomoe and Kenya when they appear together in Niji Sanji Hyakki Yagou, so I sent you a request right away!

What I would like you to draw is
Tomoe, the Spider, is messing with Kenya from behind.
She is holding her left hand around Kenya's cheek, shoulder and waist.
She is grabbing Kenya's right wrist with one of her right hands and trying to pull him closer.
It is an illustration of the composition.

I'd like everyone to see this illustration for propagation purposes, so when you tweet it on Twitter, please tag it with #tomoe #irasukoya, and if possible, please don't add the word sample.
Thank you very much!

はじめまして、ヘヴィメタル系の楽曲を制作しているVTuberの佐々野ささきと申します。
ゲーム、『俺の屍を越えてゆけ』をイメージした和風メタル系の楽曲を制作しているのですが、楽曲用のイラストを一点ご依頼できないでしょうか。

動画に適した16:9に近い横長の構図で、汚しや模様程度で構わないので簡易的な背景の入ったイラストをお願いできれば嬉しいです。

私の全身図、使用している左利きの8弦ギターの写真、当該ゲームの画像数点、作風の近しい自作曲の音源を資料URLに添付させて頂きます。

ギターは構図的に手間がかかりすぎる様でしたら、左利き（画面前面に向かって構えた時竿の部分が左を向いている）でさえあれば琵琶などに置き換えて頂いても構いません。

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/9tuuydpm2htn71m/AADnje1N7gvgyYIbixQwgYC2a?dl=0

I would love for you to write my personal Vtuber, Azumi Utagoromo!

It's a situation that actually happened, but I was in a room during a power outage, and the light from the cigarette in my mouth was like the only light. ......

The expression on her face is ennui, but she doesn't seem to be thinking about anything important. ......

By the way, her room is covered with garbage, so if you can take it into consideration to some extent ......

When you upload it to Twitter, it would be helpful if you could add the tag "#Art_as_me".

Thank you very much. m(_ _)m

https://twitter.com/As_me_V/status/1151786387760275456?s=19

Nice to meet you!
I've been curious about you since I saw your Hyakki Yakou!
I'd like to ask you to make an illustration of me to use as a thumbnail.
I'm also wearing a kimono, but I'd like to use a different outfit with a Taisho-roman, high-collar look...!
I'll leave the pose to you!
You can find my standing drawing at the URL...!

I'm looking forward to working with you...!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1p-Kzjjl0MXe5KvyRINuHxWQDL99Esi2X?usp=sharing

I'd like you to draw the Vtuber Yui Asakura for me!
m(_ _)m
The following are the details!
Dressed as a food tasting salesman (apron and triangular hood)
In the break room of the supermarket, she is taking a sip of cocoa from a light pink mug, and taking a break from her mouth.
Relaxed expression.
If you don't mind, I'd appreciate it!

推しキャラを描いて頂きたく依頼しました。

キャラクターは月姫の黒レン。

その他お任せします。

どうぞよろしくお願いします。
